## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: XBI (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND and SPY (1W: -0.64% | 1M: -1.92%) BELOW TREND — mixed signals across risk and breadth.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Credit stress marginally easing: HYG (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +0.14%) ABOVE TREND (direction: → flat) and LQD (1W: +0.67% | 1M: +1.04%) ABOVE TREND (direction: → flat). Fear declining: VXX (1W: -1.23% | 1M: -9.32%) BELOW TREND (direction: ↓ falling); but stocks vs bonds mixed as SPY BELOW TREND and TLT (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +3.05%) ABOVE TREND (direction: ↑ rising).

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Neutral: TLT (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +3.05%) ABOVE TREND shows bond bid while SPY (1W: -0.64% | 1M: -1.92%) BELOW TREND signals equity caution — overall conditions balanced.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Cyclicals and selective growth leading: XBI (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND, XLI (1W: +2.77% | 1M: +5.89%) ABOVE TREND and XLV (1W: +3.72% | 1M: +5.26%) ABOVE TREND; Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -0.54% | 1M: -0.19%) BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US internals showing bifurcation: IWM (1W: +3.12% | 1M: +3.14%) ABOVE TREND while SPY (1W: -0.64% | 1M: -1.92%) BELOW TREND. EM/China weak: EEM (1W: -0.88% | 1M: -0.13%) BELOW TREND and FXI (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -10.72%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Speculation cooling: IBIT (1W: -7.81% | 1M: -22.03%) BELOW TREND and ARKK (1W: -2.48% | 1M: -0.89%) BELOW TREND indicate drawdown in high-beta/spec trades, even as small-cap IWM ABOVE TREND attracts flows.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Metals and copper under pressure: GLD (1W: -4.93% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND and CPER (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -5.25%) BELOW TREND; contrast with energy/energy-adjacent moves as UNG (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +7.70%) ABOVE TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy largely weak: XLE (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -5.83%) BELOW TREND, BNO (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -21.13%) BELOW TREND and USO (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -20.21%) BELOW TREND — demand/price signals remain soft.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED: XBI and IWM both timeframes positive (ABOVE TREND). MAJOR divergence present: several ETFs (MTUM, XLF, ITA) show 1W vs 1M mismatch → transitional/mixed momentum.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor selective exposure to cyclicals and small caps: XBI (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +3.12% | 1M: +3.14%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to China and crypto risk: FXI (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -10.72%) BELOW TREND and IBIT (1W: -7.81% | 1M: -22.03%) BELOW TREND, with TLT (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +3.05%) ABOVE TREND to monitor for duration exposure.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Biotech/Healthcare — XBI (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials — XLI (1W: +2.77% | 1M: +5.89%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Technology — XLK (1W: -0.54% | 1M: -0.19%) BELOW TREND; China exposure — FXI (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -10.72%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Natural gas — UNG (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +7.70%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Precious metals and silver — GLD (1W: -4.93% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND, SLV (1W: -13.61% | 1M: -24.90%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX ~20 (complacency pivot), HYG/LQD spread near current levels as credit health barometer, XLK/XLF ratio at multi-week pivot (watch for tech vs financials leadership flip).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, with mixed ETF signals driving a balanced regime. Strength in cyclicals and small caps (XBI, IWM) contrasts with weakness in tech, China and speculative crypto (XLK, FXI, IBIT) — monitor divergence in momentum ETFs (MTUM, XLF) for next directional clue.
